[[ ## thread ## ]]
From: Evan Doyle
To: Gabriel Fontes, Lucia Mendes
Subject: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Urgent Resolution Needed

Gabriel, Lucia,

Following up on the CAM reconciliation for the tenant in question – we are seeing the same disputes resurface that we thought were closed. We need a firm date to resolve this and ensure the numbers are locked.

Please confirm by end of week: (1) the specific line items in dispute, (2) the documentation you have supporting each side, and (3) a proposed timeline to close this out with a signed agreement.

I expect a call with both of you next Tuesday to walk through the details. If we cannot agree, we will need to escalate per the lease terms.

Let me know if you need anything from my side to expedite.

Best,
Evan Doyle
CFO, Stonebridge Property Group

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Evan Doyle
Subject: Re: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Urgent Resolution Needed

Hi Evan,

Thanks for the follow-up. I want to address this head-on so we can close it out.

On the specific line items in dispute: the recurring items are the management fee allocation and the common area utilities allocation. For the management fee, we have the lease language that defines the base amount and the percentage cap; our calculation follows that. For utilities, we have the monthly invoices from the utility providers plus our allocation method per the lease schedule.

For documentation, we have both sides' prior correspondence and the marked-up reconciliation from the last cycle. I can send you the full package by Friday if that helps.

On timeline: I propose we have a working session next Tuesday (as you suggested) to walk through the numbers line by line. If we align on those two items, I can prepare a final reconciliation and a short memorandum of agreement for signatures by end of next week. If we can't align, we can then escalate per lease terms.

Please let me know if you need anything else from me before Tuesday. Happy to jump on a call earlier if useful.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

---

From: Evan Doyle
To: Gabriel Fontes
Subject: Re: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Confirming Tuesday Session and Deliverables

Gabriel,

Thanks for the detailed response. That covers what I need to move forward.

Confirming the working session for Tuesday. I’ll have Lucia on the call as well. Please send the full documentation package (lease language, invoices, marked-up reconciliation) by end of day Friday so we can review before we meet.

On the two line items – management fee allocation and utilities – I accept your proposed timeline: if we align Tuesday, you prepare the final reconciliation and memorandum for signatures by end of next week. If not, we escalate per lease terms.

One ask from my side: bring a clear summary of the exact dollar amounts for each disputed item, with your supporting calculation, so we can close line by line. I’ll confirm any open items from my side before Tuesday.

Let me know if you need anything from me to expedite.

Best,
Evan Doyle
CFO, Stonebridge Property Group
